step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify entities from the video visual topology and transcript: Mobile SDK (UserConsumerMobile), Public ELB (ELB), Private ELB (ELB), EKS Cluster (EKS), Queue (ThirdParty - NSQ running on spot instances), DynamoDB (DynamoDB), OLAP DB (ThirdParty - ClickHouse), S3 (S3), and Athena (Athena).
2. Establish flows based on transcript and visual arrows:
   - Flow 0 (Write Path): Mobile SDK -> Public ELB -> EKS validation microservices -> QUEUE -> EKS queue consumers -> DynamoDB, OLAP DB, S3.
   - Flow 1 (Read Path): Internal systems -> Private ELB -> EKS microservices -> Read from DynamoDB and OLAP DB.
   - Flow 2 (Troubleshooting/Replay): Athena queries S3 logs/metadata for root cause analysis and connects back to the analytical database/queue stream for replaying.

graph.name: Insider Multi-Channel Data Ingestion Architecture
graph.notes: Consolidated compute architecture on Amazon EKS using spot instances and managed node groups to process 50k write rps and 100k read rps across multi-channel traffic.

nodes.name: Mobile SDK
nodes.notes: Sends end-user application event streams and telemetry.

nodes.name: Public ELB
nodes.notes: Handles ~50,000 write requests/sec incoming traffic; provisioned by EKS.

nodes.name: Private ELB
nodes.notes: Internal gateway serving product teams with ~100,000 read requests/sec.

nodes.name: EKS
nodes.notes: Hosts ingestion validators, queue consumers auto-scaled by HPA on queue depth, and data retrieval APIs.

nodes.name: QUEUE
nodes.notes: NSQ messaging queue running on EC2 Spot instances acting as a buffer.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: NoSQL data store for fast key-value lookup.

nodes.name: OLAP DB
nodes.notes: ClickHouse database for real-time analytical processing and reporting.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Persists raw incoming traffic along with rich metadata for auditing and replay.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Performs ad-hoc SQL troubleshooting queries against S3 log data and aids in replaying historical traffic.

edges.notes: Mobile SDK sends mobile event payload to Public ELB.
Public ELB forwards write requests to validation microservices inside EKS.
EKS validation services perform light validation checks and push messages to NSQ QUEUE.
EKS consumers dynamically scaled by queue depth pull messages from NSQ QUEUE.
EKS consumers persist validated operational data into DynamoDB.
EKS consumers write analytics data to ClickHouse OLAP DB.
EKS consumers dump raw traffic logs and metadata to Amazon S3.
Internal products query data through Private ELB into EKS microservices.
EKS microservices fetch operational data records from DynamoDB.
EKS microservices fetch analytics data records from ClickHouse OLAP DB.
Athena queries raw traffic logs and metadata stored in S3 for troubleshooting.
Athena replay output streams back into analytics and storage target pipelines.
